text:
maria: quick note, hit an edge-only AbortError when moving auth refresh into middleware. Works in node but Vercel Edge throws immediately.
kevin: minimal repro?
maria: per-request. middleware does: fetch("https://auth.example/refresh",{method:'POST',signal:req.signal}) and sometimes gets AbortError right away.
sam: passing req.signal into internal retry logic is risky on Edge. Different AbortSignal semantics across runtimes (V8 vs Node). Using Next middleware or Edge Function?
maria: middleware.ts on Next 14. Using our JS SDK v0.9. SDK's fetch wrapper creates an AbortController for timeouts and forwards the outer signal.
alex: forwarding pattern?
maria: in sdkAuthFetch: const controller=new AbortController(); const signal=opts.signal; signal?.addEventListener('abort',()=>controller.abort()); return fetch(url,{...opts,signal:controller.signal});
sam: on Edge, adding a listener to an already-aborted signal invokes handler synchronously, so controller.abort() may run before fetch starts. Node's behavior differs so devs don't see it locally.
kevin: that explains immediate AbortError.
maria: tried if(!signal?.aborted) attach listener - reduced but not gone. Race still happens.
sam: instead of sync abort, use Promise.resolve().then(()=>controller.abort()) inside listener to defer. Or detect signal.aborted and avoid forwarding.
alex: other vectors: some bundles import CJS sdk in middleware, pulling in a polyfill that mutates global fetch/signal. We should ensure Edge-compatible builds are ESM-only and document import patterns.
kevin: action items: patch sdkAuthFetch to guard already-aborted signals and defer aborts (maria+sam); add Next Edge middleware e2e test in CI (kevin); docs update recommending ESM import in middleware and CJS pitfalls (alex); add tiny snippet showing recommended pattern.
maria: I'll open a PR with guard + test.
kevin: release note: "Fix: avoid synchronous AbortSignal forwarding in Edge runtimes (Next middleware)" :tada:
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled 03:00 UTC tomorrow; tag PRs with canary.
sam: QA: test on Vercel Edge, local next dev, and wrangler dev if we support Cloudflare.
maria: temporary workaround: don't pass req.signal into internal retry controllers or use safeSignal = req.signal?.aborted?undefined:req.signal.
alex: add TS typing note: accept AbortSignal|undefined and document semantic differences.
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 with tests/docs. ping for review.
kevin: reviewing now.
alex: thanks!
